item.title: Attorney General Ellison asks court to compel Trump Administration to fully fund SNAP benefits for hungry Americans during shutdown
item.description:
Publication Date: November 06, 2025

Joins coalition of 26 states in asking for temporary restraining order after Trump Administration says it will fund only a fraction of SNAP benefits for November, leaving 440,000 Minnesotans still hungry

https://www.ag.state.mn.us/Office/Communications/2025/11/06_SNAP.asp

item.title: Attorney General Ellison reaches settlement with defunct dental clinic that will enable consumers to obtain refunds
item.description:
Publication Date: November 07, 2025

Woodbury Dental Arts shut down in March 2024 and filed for bankruptcy, abandoning patients with unfinished treatments
